verdict.rationale: Docs show itemized exports with line-item tax breakdown, a taxability_reason field explaining the calculation logic, product tax codes, and address-resolution methods (IP geolocation, ship-from address), which together support reconstructing rate, category, and address logic per transaction. However there's no explicit documentation of data retention duration/policy, no audit-specific report bundling all these fields together, and no independent confirmation that exports satisfy audit requirements. Missing for 10: explicit retention/export lifecycle policy, a unified audit trail report combining rate+rules+address+category, and independent/hands-on verification of audit usability.
